install: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then python -m pip install -e .; fi

mutation.adapter: Convert tool output into targets[]; one target per source file.

notes: Profiles are reference fragments; copy/adapt them into quality-gate.yml.
Add services: or testcontainers when acceptance tests require real middleware.
Do not wrap gate commands in || true or continue-on-error.
